description: This file implements a parser for a subset of the CommonMark markdown specification, including functions for parsing markdown text, handling whitespace, indentation, and other parsing utilities.

methods.name: isEscapable
methods.description: Determines if a rune is escapable based on markdown character rules.

methods.name: isEscapableByte
methods.description: Checks if a byte is escapable by converting it to rune and using isEscapable.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a rune is a whitespace character.

methods.name: isWhitespaceByte
methods.description: Checks if a byte is whitespace by converting to rune and using isWhitespace.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a rune is a numeric digit.

methods.name: isNumericByte
methods.description: Checks if a byte is numeric.

methods.name: isHex
methods.description: Checks if a rune is a hexadecimal digit.

methods.name: isHexByte
methods.description: Checks if a byte is hexadecimal.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a rune is alphanumeric.

methods.name: isAlphanumericByte
methods.description: Checks if a byte is alphanumeric.

methods.name: isWord
methods.description: Returns true if rune matches \\w character class (alphanumeric or underscore).

methods.name: isWordByte
methods.description: Checks if a byte matches the word character class.

methods.name: nextNonWhitespace
methods.description: Returns the position of the next non-whitespace character in markdown starting from a given position.

methods.name: nextLine
methods.description: Returns the position after the next line break and whether non-whitespace characters were skipped.

methods.name: countIndentation
methods.description: Counts spaces and bytes of indentation within a given range.

methods.name: trimLeftSpace
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the start of a range.

methods.name: trimRightSpace
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the end of a range.

methods.name: relativeToAbsolutePosition
methods.description: Converts a relative position within ranges to an absolute position.

methods.name: trimBytesFromRanges
methods.description: Trims a specified number of bytes from a list of ranges.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses markdown text into a Document and reference definitions.
